name: Prag Bosimi Synthetics Limited
about: Prag Bosimi Synthetics Limited manufactures and sells polyester filament yarns in India. It operates through Packaging, Garment, Knitted Fabrics, and Others segments. The company offers texturized, dyed, and dope dyed polyester yarns; polyester partially oriented yarns; corrugated boxes; readymade garments; and fabrics. Prag Bosimi Synthetics Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Mumbai, India.
